Agent Name: Fitness_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The first clear error is when Fitness_Expert claims to have “identified” three gyms within 200 meters of Tompkins Square Park using Google Maps/Yelp, but provides no verifiable evidence and likely includes false/unsupported entries. In particular, it asserts specific gyms and later schedule findings without actually demonstrating that these gyms are within the required <200m radius or that the class times were checked from real sources. This unsupported fabrication propagates through the rest of the conversation and leads to the wrong solution.
